chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from Fazalat ibn Ayyub, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, who said:

I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Our Shia are those who are compassionate with one another; those who, when alone, remember Allah. Indeed, our remembrance is from the remembrance of Allah. We, when we are remembered, Allah is remembered; and when our enemies are remembered, Satan is remembered.'
ai.seo_question: What are the defining characteristics of the Shia according to Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) defines the true Shia through the dual traits of mutual compassion (rahmah) and constant dhikr in solitude, establishing a theological link between remembering the Imams and remembering Allah. He contrasts this divine connection with the remembrance of their enemies, which is equated with Satan, highlighting the spiritual lineage of the faithful. This concept underscores the Shia belief in the interconnection between the Imams' presence and the worshipper's devotion to God.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Our<sup>asws</sup> Shia, there is the compassion between them, those when they are alone, are mentioning Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. Our<sup>asws</sup> mention is from the Mention of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. Us<sup>asws</sup>, when we<sup>asws</sup> are mentioned, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is Mentioned, and when our<sup>asws</sup> enemies are mentioned, the Satan<sup>la</sup> is mentioned’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from his father from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Ali ibn abu Hamza who has said the following: “

I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘Our Shi’a are compassionate to each other. When alone they speak of and remember Allah. To speak of us is to speak of Allah. When we are mentioned Allah is mentioned, but when our enemies are spoken of it is like speaking of Satan.’”
